description: Error decoding (sections 8 and 3.5): with a server client built from the key ent_test_conformance_server_key, maxRetries 0 and an empty cache, make call through a fake transport that answers status, headers and body, and compare the error raised with outcome. call is, on customer(customer), check(feature), given asOf when call holds it, recordUsage(feature, amount, { idempotencyKey }), subscribe(plan, { period, idempotencyKey }), setPlan(plan, { period, idempotencyKey }), or setPlan({ sku }, { until, idempotencyKey }) when call holds sku. When call holds client, it is instead register({ idempotencyKey }) on an in-app client built from client.key and client.identityToken, with maxRetries 0 and an empty cache. Periods are named by their keys. Header names are case-insensitive, and decoding never depends on Content-Type. retryAfterSeconds is in whole seconds, so languages using milliseconds or durations convert, and null when Retry-After is absent or does not read as section 7.2 says. For an HTTP date it is the time from receivedAt, the instant the answer arrives, to that date, 0 when the date has passed: receivedAt is given only on those cases, so set the fake clock to it before the call. code is a plain string when known and { "unknown": raw } otherwise, and payment is kept only on a 402 whose payment status is declined, requires_action, processing or pending.

cases.name: feature-not-found
cases.why: A JSON error body gives code and message, and x-request-id gives requestId.
cases.body: {"error":{"code":"feature_not_found","message":"No feature has the key export_pdf in this environment."}}

outcome.message: No feature has the key export_pdf in this environment.

cases.name: customer-not-found-on-write
cases.why: An error from a write carries the idempotency key the request sent.
cases.body: {"error":{"code":"customer_not_found","message":"No customer has the id test_1001. Register them first."}}

outcome.message: No customer has the id test_1001. Register them first.

cases.name: unknown-code-kept
cases.why: A code the SDK does not know is kept as it is, never turned into another code or an error of its own.
cases.body: {"error":{"code":"quota_frozen","message":"This project's quota is frozen while its plan changes."}}

outcome.message: This project's quota is frozen while its plan changes.

cases.name: return-url-required
cases.why: return_url_required, which subscribe answers before anything changes, is a known code.
cases.body: {"error":{"code":"return_url_required","message":"This change opens the provider's page, so pass returnUrl."}}

outcome.message: This change opens the provider's page, so pass returnUrl.

cases.name: not-self-serve
cases.why: not_self_serve, the refusal of a change outside the self-serve rules, is a known code.
cases.body: {"error":{"code":"not_self_serve","message":"That move is not one the customer can make alone."}}

outcome.message: That move is not one the customer can make alone.

cases.name: billed-elsewhere
cases.why: billed_elsewhere, which setPlan answers for a store SKU when Stripe already bills the product, is a known code, and the error keeps the idempotency key.
cases.body: {"error":{"code":"billed_elsewhere","message":"Stripe already bills this product for test_1001, so a store purchase cannot replace it."}}

outcome.message: Stripe already bills this product for test_1001, so a store purchase cannot replace it.

cases.name: capability-required-for-as-of
cases.why: capability_required, which a read at another instant answers without the as_of capability, is a known code.
cases.body: {"error":{"code":"capability_required","message":"Reading at another instant needs the organisation's as_of capability."}}

outcome.message: Reading at another instant needs the organisation's as_of capability.

cases.name: registration-closed
cases.why: registration_closed, which an identity client's register() answers when the sign-in provider does not let people register themselves, is a known code.
cases.body: {"error":{"code":"registration_closed","message":"This sign-in provider does not let people register themselves."}}

outcome.message: This sign-in provider does not let people register themselves.

cases.name: unknown-fields-ignored
cases.why: Unknown fields inside error and beside it are ignored.
cases.body: {"error":{"code":"invalid_path","message":"That path is not valid.","hint":"Encode the feature key as one path segment.","docs":"https://entitler.dev/docs/errors#invalid_path"},"trace":{"span":"c41f"}}

outcome.message: That path is not valid.

cases.name: code-without-message
cases.why: A body with a good code and no message keeps the code and takes the default message.

outcome.message: Entitler answered with HTTP 400.

cases.name: message-without-code
cases.why: A body with a message and no code keeps the message and takes the code http_error.

outcome.message: That path is not valid.

cases.name: code-a-number
cases.why: An error.code that is not a string gives http_error, while a good message is still kept.
cases.body: {"error":{"code":404,"message":"No feature has the key export_pdf in this environment."}}

outcome.message: No feature has the key export_pdf in this environment.

cases.name: code-empty
cases.why: An empty error.code gives http_error, while a good message is still kept.

outcome.message: That path is not valid.

cases.name: message-empty
cases.why: An empty error.message gives the default message, while a good code is still kept.

outcome.message: Entitler answered with HTTP 400.

cases.name: message-not-a-string
cases.why: An error.message that is not a string gives the default message, while a good code is still kept.

outcome.message: Entitler answered with HTTP 400.

cases.name: json-error-body-as-text-plain
cases.why: Decoding never depends on Content-Type, so a JSON error body sent as text/plain still gives its code and message.
cases.body: {"error":{"code":"feature_not_found","message":"No feature has the key export_pdf in this environment."}}

outcome.message: No feature has the key export_pdf in this environment.

cases.name: json-error-body-without-content-type
cases.why: A JSON error body with no Content-Type header still gives its code and message.

outcome.message: This key needs the entitlements:read scope.

cases.name: html-bad-gateway
cases.why: A proxy's HTML error page is not JSON, so the code is http_error and the message the default.

outcome.message: Entitler answered with HTTP 502.

cases.name: empty-internal-error
cases.why: An empty body gives http_error and the default message.

outcome.message: Entitler answered with HTTP 500.

cases.name: plain-text-unavailable
cases.why: A plain-text body gives http_error and the default message.
cases.body: upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers

outcome.message: Entitler answered with HTTP 503.

cases.name: truncated-json-error-body
cases.why: An error body cut off mid-JSON gives http_error and the default message, not invalid_response, which is only for 2xx answers.

outcome.message: Entitler answered with HTTP 400.

cases.name: json-array-body
cases.why: A JSON body that is not an object has no error.code.

outcome.message: Entitler answered with HTTP 400.

cases.name: error-member-a-string
cases.why: An error member that is a string has no code or message.

outcome.message: Entitler answered with HTTP 400.

cases.name: json-null-body
cases.why: A JSON null body has no error.code.

outcome.message: Entitler answered with HTTP 404.

cases.name: teapot-with-empty-body
cases.why: The default message names the status, whatever it is.

outcome.message: Entitler answered with HTTP 418.

cases.name: payment-requires-action
cases.why: A 402 from setPlan, which charges through the provider, with a payment whose status is requires_action carries the payment with its url.
cases.body: {"error":{"code":"payment_required","message":"The customer must confirm the payment before the plan changes.","payment":{"status":"requires_action","url":"https://pay.example.com/confirm/pi_conformance_requires_action"}}}

outcome.message: The customer must confirm the payment before the plan changes.

cases.name: payment-declined-without-url
cases.why: A declined payment, subscribe's only 402, with a null url carries the payment with no url.
cases.body: {"error":{"code":"payment_required","message":"The card was declined. The customer keeps their plan.","payment":{"status":"declined","url":null}}}

outcome.message: The card was declined. The customer keeps their plan.

cases.name: payment-processing
cases.why: A 402 from setPlan with a payment whose status is processing keeps the payment, as one of the four known statuses.

outcome.message: The provider is still processing the payment.

cases.name: payment-pending
cases.why: A 402 from setPlan with a payment whose status is pending keeps the payment, as one of the four known statuses.

outcome.message: The payment has not succeeded yet.

cases.name: payment-unknown-status-dropped
cases.why: A payment whose status is not declined, requires_action, processing or pending gives no payment, while code and message stay.

outcome.message: The payment has not succeeded yet.

cases.name: payment-with-unknown-field
cases.why: Unknown fields inside payment are ignored.
cases.body: {"error":{"code":"payment_required","message":"The card was declined. The customer keeps their plan.","payment":{"status":"declined","url":null,"declineCode":"insufficient_funds"}}}

outcome.message: The card was declined. The customer keeps their plan.

cases.name: payment-url-a-number
cases.why: A payment url that is not a string is none, while the payment and its status stay.
cases.body: {"error":{"code":"payment_required","message":"The card was declined. The customer keeps their plan.","payment":{"status":"declined","url":42}}}

outcome.message: The card was declined. The customer keeps their plan.

cases.name: payment-url-missing
cases.why: A payment without a url on a 402 from setPlan keeps its status, with no url.

outcome.message: The provider is still processing the payment.

cases.name: payment-not-an-object
cases.why: A payment that is not an object is none, while code and message stay.

outcome.message: The payment has not succeeded yet.

cases.name: payment-null
cases.why: A null payment is none, while code and message stay.

outcome.message: The payment has not succeeded yet.

cases.name: payment-status-not-a-string
cases.why: A payment whose status is not a string has no known status, so it is none.

outcome.message: The payment has not succeeded yet.

cases.name: payment-on-a-non-402-status
cases.why: A payment is read only on a 402, so one on a 409 from setPlan is none, even with a known status and the payment_required code.
cases.body: {"error":{"code":"payment_required","message":"The customer must confirm the payment before the plan changes.","payment":{"status":"requires_action","url":"https://pay.example.com/confirm/pi_conformance_requires_action"}}}

outcome.message: The customer must confirm the payment before the plan changes.

cases.name: unavailable-with-retry-after
cases.why: Retry-After in seconds gives retryAfter.

outcome.message: Stripe is unreachable. Try again shortly.

cases.name: rate-limited-with-retry-after
cases.why: A 429 carries its code and its Retry-After.
cases.body: {"error":{"code":"rate_limited","message":"Too many requests. Try again in 5 seconds."}}

outcome.message: Too many requests. Try again in 5 seconds.

cases.name: retry-after-zero
cases.why: Retry-After 0 gives a retryAfter of zero, not none.

outcome.message: Too many requests. Try again now.

cases.name: retry-after-negative
cases.why: A Retry-After of -5 is neither ASCII digits nor an HTTP date, so retryAfter is none.

outcome.message: Stripe is unreachable. Try again shortly.

cases.name: retry-after-with-plus-sign
cases.why: A Retry-After of +5 carries a sign, so it is not ASCII digits and retryAfter is none.

outcome.message: Stripe is unreachable. Try again shortly.

cases.name: retry-after-fraction
cases.why: A Retry-After of 1.5 is not whole ASCII digits, so retryAfter is none, never rounded.

outcome.message: Stripe is unreachable. Try again shortly.

cases.name: retry-after-word
cases.why: A Retry-After that is a word is ignored, so retryAfter is none.

outcome.message: Stripe is unreachable. Try again shortly.

cases.name: retry-after-date-thirty-seconds-ahead
cases.why: A Retry-After HTTP date 30 seconds after the answer arrives gives a retryAfter of 30 seconds, measured from receipt.

outcome.message: Stripe is unreachable. Try again shortly.

cases.name: retry-after-date-passed
cases.why: A Retry-After HTTP date that passed before the answer arrived gives a retryAfter of 0, never a negative duration.

outcome.message: Stripe is unreachable. Try again shortly.

cases.name: request-id-header-in-mixed-case
cases.why: Header names are case-insensitive, so X-Request-Id gives requestId.

outcome.message: This key needs the entitlements:read scope.

cases.name: credential-not-allowed
cases.why: 403 credential_not_allowed is an ordinary ApiError.
cases.body: {"error":{"code":"credential_not_allowed","message":"This route does not take a customer token."}}

outcome.message: This route does not take a customer token.

cases.name: unauthorised-with-key
cases.why: A 401 for a fixed key fails the call with its code and message.

outcome.message: That API key is not valid.

cases.name: idempotency-mismatch-carries-key
cases.why: The error carries the caller's idempotency key, so the caller can see which key clashed.
cases.body: {"error":{"code":"idempotency_mismatch","message":"That idempotency key was used for a different request."}}

outcome.message: That idempotency key was used for a different request.

cases.name: found-redirect
cases.why: A 302 is never followed and fails with http_error.

outcome.message: Entitler answered with HTTP 302.

cases.name: moved-permanently-with-html
cases.why: A 301 is never followed and fails with http_error.

outcome.message: Entitler answered with HTTP 301.

cases.name: temporary-redirect-on-write
cases.why: A 307 on a write, which would resend the body, is never followed, and the error keeps the idempotency key.

outcome.message: Entitler answered with HTTP 307.

cases.name: permanent-redirect-on-write
cases.why: A 308 on a write is never followed either.

outcome.message: Entitler answered with HTTP 308.

cases.name: found-redirect-with-json-error-body
cases.why: A 3xx other than 304 is always http_error with the default message, even when its body is a JSON error.

outcome.message: Entitler answered with HTTP 302.

cases.name: temporary-redirect-with-json-error-body-on-write
cases.why: A 307 on a write is http_error with the default message whatever its JSON body, and keeps the idempotency key and request id.

outcome.message: Entitler answered with HTTP 307.

cases.name: not-modified-with-nothing-kept
cases.why: A 304 when the cache holds nothing for the request fails with status 304 and http_error.

outcome.message: Entitler answered with HTTP 304.

cases.name: undecodable-200-html
cases.why: A captive portal's 200 page is not JSON, so the answer is invalid_response with its fixed message.
cases.body: <html><head><title>Sign in to the network</title></head><body>Accept the terms to continue.</body></html>

outcome.message: Entitler sent an answer this SDK cannot read.

cases.name: undecodable-200-truncated-json
cases.why: A 200 cut off mid-JSON is invalid_response, and still carries requestId.

outcome.message: Entitler sent an answer this SDK cannot read.

cases.name: undecodable-200-empty
cases.why: An empty 200 is invalid_response.

outcome.message: Entitler sent an answer this SDK cannot read.

cases.name: undecodable-200-missing-fields
cases.why: A 200 that is JSON but lacks every field the check requires is invalid_response.

outcome.message: Entitler sent an answer this SDK cannot read.

cases.name: undecodable-200-error-shaped
cases.why: An error body on a 200 is not read as an error: it lacks the check's fields, so the answer is invalid_response with the fixed message.

outcome.message: Entitler sent an answer this SDK cannot read.

cases.name: undecodable-204
cases.why: A 204 with no body cannot be a check, so it is invalid_response with status 204.

outcome.message: Entitler sent an answer this SDK cannot read.
